summary: At upstream systemd commit73612ea502d53baf9b0df4336cfc296a7ee0d524, the cgroup D-Bus property surface has no MemoryOOMGroup setter. The service interface exposes OOMPolicy; service setup derives its internal memory_oom_group from whether the policy is OOM_KILL. An internal field or kernel control name is not automatically a public transient-unit property, and a local mock that accepts such a name does not prove downstream compatibility. Validate generated requests against the pinned public interface and retain actual typed kernel readback separately from manager acknowledgment. This record describes public upstream source only. It establishes no installed manager identity, runtime compatibility, workload success, cleanup, reservation release or new operation authority. Private evidence and implementation details are excluded.
title: Use the supported systemd OOM policy API and verify kernel state separately
